full_judgment: 17. It appears from the version of first information report, that the witnesses Alam, Abedul Islam and Joynal Kha are the most pertinent and material witnesses who actually recovered the LG from the waist of the accused-appellant and Chowkider Abbas Ali Sheik after getting the information went to place of occurrence along with Dafader Nurul Huq and village police Adem Ali Fakir and brought the accused Shahidul and witnesses Alam, Abedul Islam and Joynal Kha to Shibchar Police Station and lodged the first information report. Although Alam, Abedul Islam and Joynal Kha are the charge-sheeted witnesses but these three vital witnesses were not examined by the prosecution to prove the recovery of the country-made LG (light gun) from the possession of the accused. Another important witness grocery shopkeeper Jabbar Sheikh was also not examined. Because the occurrence alleged to have been taken place in front of the grocery shop of Jabbar Sheikh, as such, he was the most natural and probable witness of the case. In this case, prosecution withheld the material eye-witnesses of the case so, the adverse presumption should be drawn against the prosecution under section 114(g) of the Evidence Act.
